mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS session_id, p.analysis_attempt AS attempt, p.song_id, p.score_version, p.start_note_idx, p.end_note_idx, p.bpm, p.bpm_unit, p.recording_url, i.code AS instrument FROM practice_sessions p LEFT JOIN songs s ON s.id = p.song_id LEFT JOIN instruments i ON i.id = s.instrument_id WHERE p.id = #{sessionId} AND p.status = 'PENDING' AND p.analysis_attempt > 0 AND p.recording_url IS NOT NULL AND p.analysis_started_at >= #{startedAfter}
SELECT score_json, score_version FROM songs WHERE id = #{songId}

SELECT score_json, score_version FROM songs WHERE id = #{songId} AND score_version = #{scoreVersion} UNION ALL SELECT v.score_json, v.score_version FROM song_score_versions v JOIN songs s ON s.id = v.song_id WHERE v.song_id = #{songId} AND v.score_version = #{scoreVersion} AND s.score_version <> v.score_version
SELECT id, yul, octave, semitone FROM pitches
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO evaluations (session_id, total_score, pitch_score, timing_score, duration_score, model_version, tuning_offset_cent, tuning_out_of_range, scoring_version, score_weights) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{totalScore}, #{pitchScore}, #{timingScore}, #{durationScore}, #{modelVersion}, #{tuningOffsetCent}, #{tuningOutOfRange}, #{scoringVersion},
JSON_OBJECT('pitch', #{pitchWeight}, 'timing', #{timingWeight}, 'duration', #{durationWeight}) NULL )

INSERT INTO note_results (evaluation_id, note_idx, expected_pitch_id, detected_pitch_id, pitch_error_cent, onset_error_ms, duration_error_ms, verdict, recording_offset_ms, pitch_score, timing_score, duration_score, weight) VALUES
(#{evaluationId}, #{n.noteIdx}, #{n.expectedPitchId}, #{n.detectedPitchId}, #{n.pitchErrorCent}, #{n.onsetErrorMs}, #{n.durationErrorMs}, #{n.verdict}, #{n.recordingOffsetMs}, #{n.pitchScore}, #{n.timingScore}, #{n.durationScore}, #{n.weight})
mapper.select: SELECT status, fail_reason, analysis_attempt AS attempt, CASE WHEN analysis_timing_attempt = analysis_attempt THEN analysis_timing_id END AS analysis_timing_id FROM practice_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE practice_sessions SET status = 'PENDING', fail_reason = NULL, analysis_attempt = analysis_attempt + 1, analysis_started_at = #{startedAt}, analysis_timing_id = #{timingId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, analysis_timing_attempt = #{attempt} + 1 WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND analysis_attempt = #{attempt} AND status = 'FAILED' AND fail_reason IN ('TIMEOUT', 'SERVER_ERROR') AND recording_url IS NOT NULL
